sources.title: Liszt: Sonate in H moll — Schott, 1917
sources.locator: Sibley Music Library public-domain score. Printed p. 7 identifies the Schumann dedication and 1853 composition, and shows the Lento scales followed by the Allegro’s leaping and repeated-note gestures. The catalogue identifies Liszt’s dates, 1811–1886. This is a reference score, not an identification of Bolet’s performing edition.

sources.title: Yale University Library — Liszt’s B-minor Sonata first edition
sources.locator: Exhibit of the Breitkopf & Härtel first edition: explicit 1854 publication date, Schumann dedication, transformed themes and lack of a composer-supplied written programme.

sources.title: Franz Liszt — chronology
sources.locator: 1857 entry: first performance of the B-minor Sonata by Bülow on 22 January. The site’s existing Liszt biography separately specifies Berlin.

sources.title: Liszt Sonata — thematic and formal analysis
sources.locator: Motif derivations, slow and fugal regions, quiet ending, 1853 composition and competing formal readings; not the source for the exact publication date or named première venue.
